title: PNP says 49th Asean Summit generally peaceful despite protest actions

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday described the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits as generally peaceful despite minor disturbances following the arrest of rallyists. “For our assessment, for the whole duration of the ASEAN, generally peaceful, with some pockets of minor disturbances,” PNP spokesperson Brig. Gen. Allen Rae Co told reporters at a briefing in Camp Crame.
